title: Doodling Dragonet
statement: Hovering among frosted sea-glass arches and swaying twilight kelp, this tiny, tapestry-patterned fish uses its delicate fins to trace intricate geometric spirals into the dark volcanic sand. Whenever a visitor pauses near the tank, warm amber bioluminescence ripples across its scales in curious waves before it darts down to nudge a single pearlescent pebble into a brand-new symmetry.
